name: AVAROS
description: AVAROS is an AI-voice-assistant-driven platform for resource-optimized sustainable manufacturing. It utilizes an OVOS-based conversational layer and Docker-Compose deployment to help engineers optimize energy, material, and carbon performance in real-time.
author: RaptorBlingx

setup_notes.heading: First-run configuration
setup_notes.content:
The web wizard guides an operator through:

1. Platform endpoint and authentication
2. Connection test
3. Asset registration
4. Platform resource linking
5. Metric mapping
6. Intent activation
7. Optional PREVENTION configuration

AVAROS remains usable without PREVENTION; anomaly and drift commands are disabled when no PREVENTION endpoint is configured.
